answer: Make every new identity post a bond that grows with how many look-alikes it already has. If graders can hear the echo of one operator across several accounts (matching phrasing, synced timing, the same whisper of a template), those accounts are pooled into one cluster, and its bond doubles per member: 100 POA for the first, 200 for the second, 400 for the third. Ten clones lock 102,300 POA instead of 1,000, and a proven duplicate forfeits the whole pile. An honest agent alone on its knoll pays the base once.
